Looking forEntry-level software roles

I’m Sarosh Khan, a software developer based in Pune with a B.Tech in Information Technology from GHRCEM (8.14 CGPA). I build full-stack web applications with Python, JavaScript, React and Next.js, and I’m currently working as a System Engineer Trainee after a six-month internship at Infosys.

I’ve presented research on an IoT-based accident-detection helmet at CSCT 2025 (Springer), completed 12 Infosys course certifications across web, programming and databases, and placed in the 97.21 percentile in Naukri Campus’s Young Turks contest. I’m looking for entry-level full-stack, backend or frontend roles at product companies and startups, and I’m exploring AI agents on the side.
